name: AIB spreadsheet with white hexagram Ai mark
background: Original clean spreadsheet plate from version 3, embedded in the composition

designHistory.spreadsheetPlate: The project generated the initial green spreadsheet tile on 2026-11-18 using image generation. A subsequent image edit removed its sparkle. The cleaned plate is embedded as a PNG in aib.svg.
designHistory.familyMark: The project used a user-supplied ornament photograph as a visual reference for the six-pointed star. ai-family.svg draws the two triangles and Ai lettering with paths, a circle and a rectangle. The photograph is not included in the artwork or distribution.
designHistory.referenceRights: The author and license of the reference photograph have not been established.
